note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 2 June 1927 (queue nominal 26 May). Ballinadarragh was the only contest; the other divisions were filled by single nominations and are listed from the nomination report. No nominations were received for Aghakillymaude, Derrysteaton, Eshnafarragh or Rosslea, where the sitting members continued in office. Filed on 1927-05-25, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Fermanagh that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1927-06-02 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Coolnamarrow, Corrylongford and Derrylea are added from the Fermanagh Times, 28 April 1927, p. 6 (7 Nov 2026). Aghakillymaude, Derrysteaton, Rosslea and Eshnadarragh had no candidate; their retiring members were deemed re-elected but are not named in the sources read. Independent Unionist majority 18.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Ballinadarragh' to Ballindarragh (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1925-69 name the DED Ballindarragh; the rounds were filed as Ballindarragh (1924, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1952, 1955, 1958, 1961, 1964); Ballinadarragh (1927); Ballindarra (1949). This round was filed as 'Ballinadarragh', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (ballinadarragh) answers with a redirect to this one.
